key.name: launcher
key.description: Which home screen the home gesture opens: Phosh's own app grid or Neo. The patched Phosh (phosh 0.58.0-1+neo1 or later) reads this key; Mobile Settings shows it on the device page.

key.name: desktop-grid-columns
key.description: The home screen grid's columns. Neo Settings offers 4 × 5, 4 × 6, 5 × 5 and 5 × 6 (columns × rows; Launcher3's 5 × 5 is the default); icons a smaller grid has no cell for move to the next free one.

key.name: desktop-icon-scale
key.description: The home screen's and the dock's icons, as a share of Launcher3's 56 dp; never larger than their cells leave room for.

key.name: drawer-icon-scale
key.description: The app drawer's icons, as a share of 56 dp; never larger than its columns leave room for.

key.name: home-widgets
key.description: The weather and an analog clock across the top two rows of the first page.

key.name: desktop-hide-app-labels
key.summary: Hide labels on the home screen

key.name: icon-pack
key.description: Directory name of an icon pack under neo-launcher/iconpacks in the user's data dir (~/.local/share) or a system one (/usr/local/share, /usr/share): pack.json, gnome-map.json, icons/. Empty: the theme's icons.

key.name: icon-wrap-unthemed
key.summary: Wrap icons the pack does not cover in its own background

key.name: icon-shape-legacy
key.summary: Draw icons without pack art on a shaped background

key.name: search-drawer-enabled
key.summary: Search field at the top of the app drawer
key.description: Off: no search pill, and the app list starts where it was.

key.name: hidden-from-home
key.summary: Apps removed from the home screen (still in the drawer)

key.name: wallpaper-parallax
key.description: A directory with parallax.json and its layer pictures (back to front); the layers shift by their depth as the phone tilts. Empty: the GNOME wallpaper, still.

key.name: lock-type
key.description: pin: Phosh's keypad. pattern: a 3x3 dot grid on the lock screen, the dots in order are the password. swipe: no password (Phosh's require-unlock off).

key.name: finger-max-misses
key.description: How many touches the sensor may reject before only the PIN or the pattern unlocks, until it is used. The keyguard counts one miss per run of the sensor, and each run takes one touch.

key.name: finger-retry-count
key.description: How many times the lock screen arms the sensor again after an attempt found nothing to arm (fprintd not on the bus, the sensor not claimed, the helper missing). 0: one attempt per wake and per lock.

key.name: finger-retry-delay-ms
key.description: How long to wait before arming the sensor again, in milliseconds.

key.name: lock-over-window
key.summary: App windows over the lock screen
key.description: An app whose desktop file says X-GnomePhone-ShowWhenLocked may show its window over the lock screen (the kiosk, a ringing alarm, a call coming in). Off: every app window stays behind the lock screen. Either way the lock screen keeps the input, so a swipe up brings the PIN pad and a finger on the sensor unlocks.

key.name: lock-swipe-slop
key.description: How far a finger travels up the lock screen before the swipe starts, in dp. It applies over an app window too, which the same swipe takes the lock screen back from.

key.name: double-tap-wake
key.description: While the screen is off the touchscreen waits in its low power mode for a double tap, which wakes the screen.

key.name: aod
key.description: When the screen goes off, the panel stays on, black, with the time, the date, the battery and the apps with notifications in dim grey.
